title: Publish V4 Guards 1.1.1 composition patch
goal: Finalize release-safe 1.1.1 package documentation, recertify one exact source commit and archive, publish the authorized tag and GitHub Release, and verify a new side-by-side installation without approving an IFX bundle or cutover.
acceptanceCriteria: The 1.1.1 tag and Release are absent before publication and the remote development branch can be advanced by an exact fast-forward to the newly certified commit.

Package README, release notes, certification guide and Web Companion guide contain release-safe wording; changed authority bytes are recertified on Windows-full and pinned network-disabled Linux-complete against one clean commit and package hash.
The deterministic 1.1.1 archive and SHA-256 sidecar match the new certification record, and the same archive passes installed-path synthetic composition on Linux and Windows.
An annotated v4-guards-v1.1.1 tag points to the exact certified commit, and a final GitHub Release V4 Guards 1.1.1 contains only the certified ZIP and sidecar with matching remote digests.
The published archive is installed into a new sibling v4-guards-1.1.1 directory with an external verified release receipt, without changing the 1.1.0 installation or receipt.
Publication and local installation evidence are recorded; no real ifx_profile bundle approval, remote workflow/ruleset change, IFX cutover, or V3 retirement occurs.
